description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractDevOpsCommand' that implements the 'DevOpsCommand' interface. It provides shared functionality for DevOps command classes, including handling optional service name and instance identifiers, payload appending, and standard object methods.

classes.name: AbstractDevOpsCommand
classes.description: An abstract generic class implementing common functionality for DevOps commands, including optional service name and instance, and payload serialization.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the service name if available.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the instance identifier if available.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command's payload to a JSON object, including service name and instance if present.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on superclass, service name, and instance.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on class type, superclass equality, and matching service name and instance.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method to support proper equality checks in inheritance.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object including service name, instance, and superclass info.
